components.name: Zendesk Sidebar Application Host
components.purpose: Hosts the embedded Zendesk sidebar interface for support staff.
components.rationale: Firebase Hosting delivers fast static asset hosting for web integrations.
components.security_considerations: Enforce HTTPS static asset delivery with secure headers.

components.name: Core Agent Assist Backend Service
components.purpose: Orchestrates prompt building, retrieval, classification, routing, and drafting.
components.rationale: Cloud Run provides serverless execution with dynamic auto-scaling.
trade_offs: Cold start latency on initial scaling.
components.security_considerations: Enforce IAM authentication and private VPC connectivity.

components.name: Integration API Gateway
components.purpose: Exposes secure endpoints for Zendesk webhook events and agent requests.
components.rationale: API Gateway provides managed token validation and rate limiting.
components.security_considerations: Validates JWT tokens from Zendesk and enforces rate limits.

components.name: Operational Relational Database
components.purpose: Stores operational metadata, 24-month audit records, and quality scores.
components.rationale: Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL offers fully managed relational storage with audit support.
trade_offs: Requires connection pooling for high concurrency.
components.security_considerations: Encrypts data at rest using customer keys within EU regions.

components.validation_reason: Identity federation details with Zendesk require validation.
components.name: Enterprise Identity Service
components.purpose: Authenticates Zendesk sidebar users and handles token verification.
components.rationale: Identity Platform integrates with OAuth 2.0 and signed JWT authentication.
components.security_considerations: Enforces short-lived tokens and signature validation.

components.name: Ingestion Event Bus
components.purpose: Decouples ingestion workflows and asynchronous ticket processing jobs.
components.rationale: Pub/Sub delivers resilient messaging for background pipelines.
components.security_considerations: Restricts topic access using granular IAM permissions.

components.name: Multi-Source Data Ingestion Orchestrator
components.purpose: Schedules bi-weekly synchronization across Confluence, GitHub, and SharePoint.
components.rationale: Cloud Composer provides managed Airflow workflows for data ingestion.
trade_offs: Base cost higher for smaller workloads.
components.security_considerations: Stores integration credentials securely in Secret Manager.

components.name: Enterprise Vector and Hybrid Search Index
components.purpose: Indexes document embeddings and historical tickets for similarity retrieval.
components.rationale: Vertex AI Vector Search delivers low-latency similarity searches at scale.
trade_offs: Requires automated re-indexing on document updates.
components.security_considerations: Restricts vector queries to private VPC endpoints.

components.name: EU-Resident Foundation Language Models
components.purpose: Generates grounded reply drafts, ticket categories, and priority ratings.
components.rationale: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform guarantees EU regional data processing.
components.security_considerations: Enforces EU data residency and strict non-training policies.

components.name: PII Redaction and Content Safety Filter
components.purpose: Redacts PII, credentials, and hostnames prior to model invocation.
components.rationale: Sensitive Data Protection provides automated masking and de-identification.
trade_offs: Adds minor latency overhead to prompt preparation.
components.security_considerations: Audits all redaction operations for compliance verification.

components.name: Application Telemetry and Monitoring
components.purpose: Aggregates system logs, audit records, and application metrics.
components.rationale: Cloud Logging provides native centralization for operational logs.
trade_offs: Extended log retention increases storage cost.
components.security_considerations: Enforces log immutability and restricted access policies.

components.name: Secrets and Cryptographic Key Management
components.purpose: Stores API keys, OAuth tokens, and database credentials securely.
components.rationale: Secret Manager provides encrypted key storage with IAM controls.
components.security_considerations: Encrypts secrets at rest and audits access events.

components.name: Container Image Registry
components.purpose: Stores microservice container images for backend deployments.
components.rationale: Artifact Registry integrates with GCP deployment tools and vulnerability scanning.
components.security_considerations: Scans container images for vulnerabilities before release.

components.name: Centralized Infrastructure Configuration
components.purpose: Manages declarative infrastructure resources across all environments.
components.rationale: Infrastructure Manager automates GCP resource provisioning via Terraform.
components.security_considerations: Enforces RBAC for infrastructure deployment pipelines.

components.name: Application Gateway WAF
components.purpose: Protects public API endpoints against web exploits and DDoS attacks.
components.rationale: Google Cloud Armor provides edge security and IP rate limiting.
trade_offs: Requires rule tuning to avoid false positives.
components.security_considerations: Blocks malicious traffic signatures at the edge.

components.name: Automated Cloud Backup Manager
components.purpose: Automates backup routines and snapshot retention for database instances.
components.rationale: Backup and DR Service provides centralized backup lifecycle management.
trade_offs: Snapshot storage incurs additional storage fees.
components.security_considerations: Ensures snapshots are encrypted with managed keys.

environments.dev: Isolated dev environment with scaled-down Cloud Run and Cloud SQL instances for active development.
environments.test: Staging environment matching production architecture for integration testing and quality evaluations.
environments.prod: Production environment deployed in EU regions enforcing strict residency, high availability, and security controls.

deployment_runtime.text: Microservices run as containerized instances on Cloud Run deployed from Artifact Registry. Declarative infrastructure management across environments is provided by Infrastructure Manager.

availability_scalability.text: Cloud Run automatically scales container instances based on incoming request volume to handle peak daily workloads. Google Cloud Armor and Cloud Load Balancing distribute traffic and enforce edge protection.

backup_dr.text: Automated backups of operational data and audit logs are managed by Backup and DR Service and stored in Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL. Multi-region storage options ensure recovery objectives are met in EU regions.

observability.text: Centralized logging and telemetry are collected by Cloud Logging across all microservices and API gateways. Audit logs for generated responses and source citations are persisted for 24 months.

security_controls.text: Sensitive Data Protection redacts PII and hostnames before model invocation. Secret Manager and Cloud Armor enforce access controls, encrypted secrets, and web application firewall security.
